1) What is your name? Real & Ingame - my real name is tomer my name in game is superman g2a.com


2) How old are you? - im 15 years old


3) Why do you want to join our administrative team? - i want to join to the adminstravite team because THIS SERVER IS AWESOME and because i want to translation for you what the Israeli community talks in hebrew because sometimes they say how much HP a player got or curse each other in hewbrew and the admins dont understand what they say


4) How long have you been playing on our servers? - i played on your server alomost a year and i will continue to play

7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before? -yes i had a lot of expirience. i was an admin in my friend isreali bhop server (it doesn't exist anymore)


[8)] When do you play? (timetable of your average week) - I play like 80 hours in one week. on your servers i play like 36 hours


9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take? - First i will warn user 1. If user 1 will continue to curse user 2 i will kick him. If he will keep curse user 1 i would ban him for 30 min. if after 30 min he still keep to curse user 1 i will ban him for 1 day (24 hours)

i know to speck hebrew so when someone curses in Hebrew I knew what he said

Unfortunately, that's a No from me.
There are several things that speak against you as an administrator.


  • You're too young. You have to be at least 16 years old to apply
  • I don't know you. I haven't seen you on the server at all, unless you play under a different name
  • Your english is average at best and therefore most likely not good enough for an admin

    • This applies to your grammar as well
  • Supposedly, you play 80 hours in one week and 36 hours on our servers. That would be a total playtime of 11.43 hours a day. That is a really high number. I don't believe it.
  • Also, your profile here says that you've played 32.6 hours in the last TWO weeks. So I don't buy the "80 hours a week" statement.


EDIT: 6. You said, that you've been playing on our servers for about a year now. May I know how many Stamm points you've got? Because I don't believe you. You've received your first few CS:GO achievements in June 2015. I guess that is when you start playing actively. You can't play on our servers for half a year without making 25 kills, planting a bomb or win 10 rounds.


So yeah, you've been lying about your total play time on our servers twice.

I give you a Yes.
You'll be accepted, trust me [;)]
